scope: Single-paper bounded screen; PMC11237882 and its public supplements only; no other receptor pooled

source.title: Elaboration of the Homer1 recognition landscape reveals incomplete divergence of paralogous EVH1 domains

engineering_pilot.reason: Same-background gain/loss numeric measurements exist; exact SUMO-peptide analyte architecture and mutation-label uncertainty handling must be resolved first

failed_full_benchmark_gates: At most 9 effect-label candidates, fewer than 10; 2 uncertain pairs excluded
Only 2 point-estimate gain candidates, fewer than 4

receptor.name: Homer1 EVH1
receptor.construct_source: Table S4, EVH1 Domains row 2, Purpose BLI
receptor.numbering: Source EVH1 sequence starts at M; exact amino acid sequence audited, canonical full-protein accession mapping not independently checked in this single-paper scope
receptor.tag_removal: Methods 4.1 reports TEV cleavage, reverse Ni-NTA and gel filtration
receptor.tag_remnant_status: SNA inferred from ENLYFQ|SNA; experimental mature N terminus not sequenced in source
receptor.mbp: No MBP construct described in this paper; BLI peptide is SUMO fusion

peptide_chemistry.assay_analyte: Biotinylated SUMO-peptide, expressed in E. coli via pDW363, Ni-NTA purification; no SUMO cleavage reported
peptide_chemistry.biotin: In vivo biotinylation with 0.05 mM D-(+)-biotin; site and exact full fusion sequence not supplied in retrieved supplementary data
peptide_chemistry.fusion_orientation: Not explicitly fixed by full sequence in source; do not silently infer
peptide_chemistry.peptide_N_terminal_chemistry: Not a standalone free peptide; fusion context, exact junction unspecified
peptide_chemistry.peptide_C_terminal_chemistry: Full fusion/junction sequence unspecified; do not claim synthetic amidation or free isolated peptide
peptide_chemistry.spot_array_is_different: SPOT N-terminus acetylated Gly-Ser linker, C-terminal PEG-cellulose, native Cys replaced Ala. These chemistry rules belong to SPOT only, not BLI.

assay.temperature: room temperature, exact degrees not given
assay.buffer: 1:1 mixture of 20 mM HEPES pH 7.6 /150 mM NaCl /1 mM DTT gel filtration buffer and 1x PBS pH 7.6 /1 mM DTT /1% BSA /0.1% Tween-20
assay.immobilization: streptavidin tips, biotinylated SUMO-peptides target 0.5-1 nm
assay.equilibrium_signal: mean last 10s association minus mean last 10s dissociation; SUMO-only control subtracted
assay.fit: nonlinear least squares in Kaleidagraph; y=C*[EVH1]/(Kd+[EVH1])
assay.shared_preparation_or_pairing: Not reported; cannot assume independent biological samples or pairing
assay.censoring: >150 uM entries retained as strict lower bounds; not set equal to 150
assay.proline_cis_trans: Authors explicitly note slow cis/trans phase and primarily measured binding to peptide population with appropriate preexisting proline conformations; assay-conditioned affinity must be preserved

structures.1DDV: Paper cites Homer1 complex with representative PPSTF-containing ligand; not the assayed DVL3/ABI3/FAT1 mutant series or SUMO fusion
structures.5ZZ9: Homer2-DBN1 complex cited by paper; paralog is not BLI Homer1, exact construct and fusion differ
structures.pdb_database_reinspection: Outside this single-paper-only audit; not claimed checked

independence.project_selection_exposure: Delegated to parent project audit, not verified here
independence.graphpep_training_overlap: Not audited here; cannot claim clean
independence.publication_prior_analysis: Publication of motif/biochemical analysis or other-model use is not by itself overlap with this project or scorer training

no_computation: No structure prediction, scoring, model download or paid/third-party contact performed
